structured.answer: Basically nothing on this page is computed yet. Every card is tagged "לא מחושב" until the tax and rules questions are settled. That covers ETCs, gold funds, currency-hedged funds, dollar deposits and FX fees, bonds and נע"מ, structured products and deposits, ביטוח מנהלים and participating policies, קרן י', commuted pension, exempt payments and תיקון 190, REITs and digital portfolios. On top of that, single stocks, trading and derivatives, mortgages, physical real estate and ranking by past return are permanently out of scope.
